_doc: Lagu unit (SP 7.1.1-7.1.6). Draf: python tools/songs/make_song.py games/T1-U07-magnet -> songs_draft/. Semak sebutan bahasa Melayu Malaysia sebelum guna.
title: Lagu Magnet
caption: cheerful children's educational song, Malaysian Malay lyrics, bright clear female vocal with kids choir on chorus, ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, light drums, upbeat bouncy pop, simple catchy melody, major key
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Magnet bar, magnet ladam
Bentuk U, butang, cincin
Ada juga yang silinder
Namanya ikut bentuknya!

[Chorus]
Magnet, magnet, tarik, tarik!
Paku, skru, klip, kunci besi
Pensel, guli, pemadam tidak
Magnet hebat, jom kita uji!

[Verse 2]
Kutub utara, kutub selatan
Kutub berlainan tarik-menarik
Kutub yang sama tolak-menolak
Dekatkan, lihat, cuba fikir!

[Chorus]
Magnet, magnet, tarik, tarik!
Paku, skru, klip, kunci besi
Pensel, guli, pemadam tidak
Magnet hebat, jom kita uji!

[Outro]
Peti sejuk, tanda nama
Magnet berguna setiap hari!
